newsitem.title: BULGARIA: UFO SPOTTED AT BULGARIA MILITARY COMPETITION - NEWSPAPER.
newsitem.headline: UFO SPOTTED AT BULGARIA MILITARY COMPETITION - NEWSPAPER.

text.p: Bulgarian army officers spotted an Unidentified Flying Object (UFO) at a military competition Rambo '97 over the eastern town of Sliven, some 300 km east of Sofia, local media said on Monday.

"A milky-white object emerged suddenly during the paratrooper competition, passed with the speed of lightning above the military AN-2 aircraft and then simply vanished in the air," the Standart daily said.
It said senior officers, monitoring the competition with powerfull binoculars jumped from their seats and followed its trajectory in dismay.

"We managed to make photos and will try to investigate what is it excatly that flew over the airfield...it resembled a hybrid between a supersonic jet and a glider," Standart quoted a senior officer as saying.
Defence ministry officials declined comment, refusing either to confirm or reject the story.
